# QR Generator – Custom QR Code

> Free Android app (Google Play: com.sananhaji.qrgenerator) that makes QR codes from any link or text, plain or styled with a center logo, custom colors, pixel and eye shapes and a background picture. No ads, no account, no watermark, works offline. Saves 1024 × 1024 PNG.

## Links

- [Landing page](https://sananhaji.github.io/QRgenerator/): features, screenshots and FAQ
- [Google Play listing](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.sananhaji.qrgenerator): install the app
- [Privacy policy](https://sananhaji.github.io/QRgenerator/privacy-policy.html): what data the app collects

## Facts

- Platform: Android 7.0+. Languages: English, Azerbaijani.
- Codes are static and never expire.
- Logo: any picture, adjustable size and shape; error correction rises automatically.
- Background photo with an option that keeps the corner eyes readable.
- Not supported: QR scanning, dynamic QR, scan statistics.
